statement_title: Estimate of the Expenditure and Revenue of the United States during the year 1796
accounting_basis: probable receipts and expenditures including expected customs and a financing gap
principal_risk: forecast prepared during the year; customs amount is expected rather than realized

statement_title: Report of the Commissioners of the Sinking Fund
accounting_basis: cumulative stock purchases and specie paid plus pending cash and loan activity
principal_risk: combines cumulative purchases current balances and intended future application

statement_title: Statement of the Purchases of Public Stock by the Agents to the Trustees named in the Act for the Reduction of the Public Debt
accounting_basis: stock face values by class and specie moneys expended
principal_risk: face value of stock purchased must remain separate from cash expended; cumulative interval

statement_title: Statement of the application of moneys drawn from appropriations for reduction of the six per cent stock bearing a present interest
accounting_basis: cash drawn from interest and combined customs and internal-revenue proceeds for principal reimbursement
principal_risk: source line combines import and tonnage duties with domestic distilled-spirits duties so customs funding cannot be isolated

statement_title: Report and accounts for sale of United States Bank stock and application to bank debts
accounting_basis: asset-sale proceeds received into Treasury then applied to named bank-loan instalments
principal_risk: sale proceeds and six-percent-stock borrowing are combined in the 1.2 million dollar application; transaction dates require reconstruction

statement_title: Statement exhibiting Drawbacks paid on dutiable articles exported compared with Duties collected on the same
accounting_basis: annual duties received and drawbacks paid by article; 1795 note adds late collector detail
principal_risk: duties received are not explicitly described as cash received into Treasury; 1795 drawback printed total requires the page 104 adjustment

statement_title: Public Debt report in obedience to House resolution of June 1 1796
accounting_basis: retrospective synopsis of statements A through H
principal_risk: summary mixes debt stocks cash payments loan balances bank stock and accrued uncollected customs bonds

statement_title: Statement of the foreign and domestic debts of the United States including assumed debt on January 1 1790
accounting_basis: debt principal interest estimates and assumed debt stock
principal_risk: stock and estimated claim measure rather than annual cash flow

statement_title: Statement of the foreign and domestic debts of the United States including assumed debt on January 1 1791
accounting_basis: debt principal interest and assumed debt stock
principal_risk: stock measure rather than annual cash flow

statement_title: General Statement of payments made from funds of the present Government for claims or balances contracted by the late Government
accounting_basis: retrospective annual cash payments for legacy claims
principal_risk: narrow legacy-claim subset is not total federal expenditure and spans uneven annual accounts

statement_title: General Statement of moneys paid into the Treasury for balances due on accounts originating under the late Government
accounting_basis: retrospective annual cash receipts into Treasury from legacy account recoveries
principal_risk: narrow recovery subset must not be mistaken for total receipts; individual-year totals need second transcription

statement_title: Statement of anticipations at the close of each year from 1791 to 1795 inclusive
accounting_basis: year-end foreign-fund replacement balances and unpaid domestic-loan balances
principal_risk: closing loan liabilities and replacement balances are not annual loan proceeds

statement_title: Statements of moneys transferred and foreign-loan proceeds applied to foreign debt and other purposes during 1791 through 1795
accounting_basis: annual foreign-loan transfers interest payments expenditures closing balances and unpaid domestic loans
principal_risk: each account mixes opening balances financing flows debt-service uses closing balances and loan stocks; only compatible components may enter ratios

statement_title: Statement of the foreign and domestic debt including assumed debt on January 1 1796
accounting_basis: foreign and domestic debt stock plus unpaid bank loans
principal_risk: stock measure including estimated and unregistered debt rather than annual cash flow

statement_title: Statement of Debts extinguished by the Sinking Fund to the close of 1795 by appropriation
accounting_basis: stock extinguished by class and moneys expended by appropriation
principal_risk: cumulative cash and stock measures coexist; period allocation is unavailable in this table

statement_title: Estimate of sums expected from import-duty bonds accrued to the close of 1795 after drawbacks and collection expenses
accounting_basis: estimated accrued and uncollected net customs bonds
principal_risk: explicit estimate of future collections from accrued bonds; not realized cash

statement_title: Report concerning the internal revenues of the United States
accounting_basis: returns received at Treasury supplemented by estimates for deficient returns
principal_risk: report explicitly combines returns estimates accrued revenue and expected collection; periods differ by tax

statement_title: Statements of revenue from distilled spirits auction sales snuff mills refined sugar carriages and retailer licences
accounting_basis: district returns with gross duties discounts drawbacks payable duties and estimates for missing returns
principal_risk: not a common annual interval; several districts and quarters are estimated or missing; payable and collected fields must not be treated as Treasury cash

statement_title: General Statement and Estimate of the Internal Revenues exhibiting the net amount for one year
accounting_basis: revenue payable by source and district less salaries commissions compensation and incidental collection expenses
principal_risk: explicitly a statement and estimate; mixed underlying periods and missing returns prevent admission as cash received into Treasury
